# Recreation Prompt

Create a single-file browser-native canvas game titled **Camp Last Laugh: Mask on the Lake**. Preserve the mechanics of a touch-first survival-evasion loop: the player holds or drags on the canvas to move a small avatar toward the pointer, collects all required pickups by proximity, watches a threat meter rise, avoids a pursuing enemy that activates after pressure builds, wins when all pickups are collected, loses when the enemy catches them, and can restart from the end overlay.

Reinterpret the game as satirical camp-slasher survival. The player is the Final Counselor collecting canoe escape-kit pieces around a moonlit lake camp. The enemy is a relentless hockey-mask stalker emerging from pine trees. Use procedural Canvas art: moonlit lake, dock, cabins, pine silhouettes, warning signs, campfire embers, flashlight cone, glowing kit pieces, mask jumpscare, and VHS grain. Keep HUD labels short and mobile-readable: Escape Kit, Mask Signal, Tree Line, Cabin Porch, Dock Steps, In The Beam. Use a horror display title font and clean condensed UI font from the approved catalog. Integrate approved dark/eerie/tense remote audio only as user-gesture-safe background and feedback.
blueprint_markdown:
<!-- v5 source truth blueprint -->
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: mobile-first canvas survival-evasion chase game.
- objective: drag a survivor around a full-screen playfield, collect all required pickups, and avoid the pursuing masked threat.
- input model: pointer/touch target movement on the canvas; release cancels movement; restart is a normal button click/tap.
- core loop: initialize survivor, scatter pickups, move toward player touch, collect by proximity, raise threat over time and with pickups, activate a chaser, render procedural scene every frame.
- fail/friction state: after threat activation the masked pursuer follows the player; close contact for a brief timer triggers a scare and game-over overlay. Collecting all pickups wins.

## Protected mechanics
- Pointer drag/hold anywhere on the canvas moves the avatar toward that point.
- Survivor speed, bounds clamping, animation-frame update cadence, and proximity-based pickup collision remain intact.
- Collection score remains `collected / total`; default total remains 8 and can be configured by `pagesToCollect`.
- Threat rises with time and collected items, changes HUD thresholds, activates a pursuing enemy, and causes failure on close contact.
- Win occurs only when all pickups are collected; loss occurs only when the pursuer catches the survivor; restart fully resets state.

## Remixed target
`Camp Last Laugh: Mask on the Lake` is a satirical camp-slasher survival game. The survivor is the Final Counselor improvising an escape kit around a moonlit summer camp while a relentless hockey-masked slasher stalks from the tree line. The same collection-and-evasion loop becomes gathering canoe plugs, keys, flare tape, and gas-can parts before the mask reaches flashlight range. The rebuilt presentation uses procedural cabins, pine walls, lake reflections, VHS grain, warning signs, flashlight cones, and mobile-readable HUD copy while preserving the exact mechanical truth above.
